title: Sub-workflow Node
description: Execute another workflow as a sub-workflow in reference mode. The parent workflow invokes the child workflow and waits for its completion.

workflow_id.description: UUID of the selected child workflow in the same Project (latest published version).

trigger_node_id.description: Graph node ID of the Subworkflow Trigger to invoke in the child workflow

input_mapping.description: Mapping of child workflow input field names to static values or template expressions. Keys are child workflow input field names; values can be static types (string, int, bool, dict, list) or template expression strings (${step_id.field.path}).

StandardOutputWrapper.description: Standard output envelope for Step SDK. All step outputs follow this structure.

Result.description: Primary task return payload (type varies by step)

StatusCode.description: Execution status code (0=success, non-zero=failure per POSIX convention)

SubWorkflowOutputResult.description: Child execution metadata for Sub-workflow steps.

child_execution_id.description: UUID of the child workflow execution instance (null if invocation failed)

child_workflow_id.description: UUID of the invoked child workflow definition

child_workflow_name.description: Human-readable name of the child workflow

child_workflow_version.description: Version number of the child workflow that was invoked

child_status.description: Terminal execution status of the child workflow (reference mode: parent blocks until child completes, so only terminal statuses are returned)

outputs.description: Child workflow terminal step outputs. Keys are child step IDs, values are StandardOutputWrapper envelopes. May be null if authorization denied.

SubWorkflowOutput.description: Output model for Sub-workflow steps. Follows StandardOutputWrapper structure with Result containing child execution metadata.
